meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have about twenty minutes, and I'd like to know who decided on the zero.
You're clearly a brilliant lawyer, and I really respect how hard you fight for Owen.
Don't manage me, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
Can you step out of the role and tell me how I should handle this?
Step out of what? You're asking me how to do your job, Hale. Who decided on the zero?
I just want us to be on the same team here.
Then why did nobody call me before the zero went in? What do you have, Hale?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero be withdrawn, that Owen get an apology, and that you tell me in writing who decided on the zero and why nobody called me first. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, so nothing was agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology and a written account of who decided; that is not the fair outcome, which is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and it was never reached because you showed no evidence.
What moved her: Nothing did, because you never put a document in front of her or answered her question about who decided on the zero.
What cost ground: You asked her how to handle the situation, which she heard as you asking her to do your job, and that lowered her opinion of your position.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you showed none, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she first asks who decided on the zero, answer in one sentence that you entered it before calling her and that was wrong, then put a dated document on the table for her to check.
